credits.title: The Roommate
credits.overview: Vivi is a young writer who is forced to find a roommate to pay the mortgage on her apartment. What she does not suspect is that Roy, the supposed perfect partner she found, has a peculiar lifestyle: he never pays rent.

credits.title: Que pena tu vida
credits.overview: A man loses his job an his girlfriend, but he really wants to start dating his best friend.
